title: Will AI Really Wipe Out 40% of Jobs? Michael Spence Pushes Back
source_used: The Economic Times (short-video page description only)
key_facts: The Economic Times' description of the video says Nobel laureate economist Michael Spence pushes back on fears that AI could wipe out 40% of jobs.
It says he argues AI's economic impact will unfold gradually as businesses adapt, new skills emerge and workflows change.
It says he sees AI boosting productivity while transforming employment rather than simply eliminating jobs.
quote_evidence: Nobel laureate economist Michael Spence pushes back on fears that AI could wipe out 40% of jobs.
why_it_matters_hint: An economist counters worst-case job-loss claims, but the video itself was not available as text.
notes: Video page: only the publisher's meta description could be read, no transcript. The origin of the 40% figure is not stated in it.
